items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: He was in the Army with me.

ctx.x: Is that who you're talking about? Yeah, yeah.

Who was in the band with Hippolyte Charles? Who was in the band with Hippolyte Charles? Who was in the band with Hippolyte Charles? Who was in the band with Hippolyte Charles? Who was in the band with Hippolyte Charles?
Ray Degas, Camilla Todd, and Robert Hall.
